quick_context: aahp-hub v0.1.0 - web dashboard for the AAHP runner. Three tasks done. T-003 just landed: SSE endpoint at /api/stream watches ~/.aahp/sessions.json + metrics.jsonl mtime; client EventSource fires router.refresh() on change with 250ms debounce, plus a 30s polling fallback. Cards get a pulsing dot and a session row when an agent runs. Defensive coercion in lib/manifest.ts now handles non-spec manifests (array tasks, object quick_context). Open: T-001 tests, T-004 abort (runner endpoint needed), T-005 token tracking (runner-side change).
